resources.string: Limits Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok short videos. TikTok can allow videos opened from chats while blocking its video feeds.

If your bank asks you to disable accessibility, use this shortcut to pause QuietFeed.

Set up once
1. Open Settings → Accessibility → Accessibility shortcuts (or Advanced settings).
2. Choose Side and Volume up buttons, then select Accessibility.

Before banking
Press Side/Power + Volume Up together. Choose Accessibility if a menu appears. Open Installed apps → QuietFeed: Shorts Blocker screen filter and turn it Off.

After banking
Use the shortcut again and turn the same service On. Your app choices stay saved; blocking pauses while the service is off.

The Off choices inside QuietFeed do not disable its accessibility access. Menu names vary by phone.
